title: Torque-converter-clutch solenoid circuit fault
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM detected an electrical problem in the circuit controlling the torque-converter-clutch solenoid.
failureCriteria: Exact application-specific electrical feedback criteria are not yet verified.

likelyCauses.cause: Poor contact at the transmission pass-through connector
Shorted or open internal transmission harness

falsePositiveConditions: A shared ignition-feed fault can set multiple transmission electrical codes.
confirmatoryTests: Check for other codes that share the transmission ignition feed.
Verify power at the TCC solenoid circuit.
Test the internal harness and TCC solenoid for an open or short.
